# Study Tool Maintenance Skill

1. Search for an existing equivalent before creating new code.
2. Reuse shared components and utilities.
3. Keep all academic/user data processing in the browser.
4. Follow the indigo design system and accessible controls.
5. Add sample/demo, reset/clear, copy/export, and error handling as appropriate.
6. Keep route, metadata, README, and documentation synchronized.
7. Do not run production builds for documentation-only, README-only, or .github-only changes.
8. For source changes, run lint and production build.

Completion: privacy preserved, UI accessible/responsive, routes preserved, tool complete, SEO/docs synchronized, source checks clean.
